_meta.title: ASHEN REALM — Metin2 reference catalog
_meta.scope: Reference catalog and implementation planning for a Metin2-inspired browser MMORPG.
_meta.accuracy: Catalog includes source-checked individual Metin Stone pages for four examples. Drop lists are wiki-listed outcomes, not probabilities; partial page captures are explicitly marked. Server/version differences may apply.
_meta.dropPolicy: Do not fabricate exact drop chances or per-monster item sources. Fill those only from a cited item page or version-matched mob_drop_item/common_drop_item/special_item_group data.

notes: Book names were expanded against the official category listing of 75 pages; many records only have category-list confirmation, not detailed effects/drop sources.
Upgrade item names were expanded from the official Upgrade Items table. The current page includes both upgrade materials and a separate craft-items table; some entries appear in both.
Do not use category-list-only entries to generate gameplay drops or recipes until their individual item pages and version are verified.
Per-monster drop tables remain empty pending source-level verification.

officialBooksIndex is the exact 75-name index from the wiki category page. books contains additional selected entries and is not expected to equal 75; reconcile individual item pages before treating it as a canonical full list.
The wiki Books table also includes Young Pet Book; included as a book-system entry even though the category listing extraction returned 74 names.
Starter monster EXP was checked against individual pages; Alpha Wolf corrected from 51 to 41 EXP.
Monster dropItems list items shown under Other Drops on individual wiki pages; exact probability is not provided and remains null. Item type labels are descriptive, not claims about drop mechanics.
Added individual-page records for Blue Wolf, Grey Wolf, Cursed Wolf, Cursed Blue Wolf, Cursed Alpha Wolf, Cursed Alpha Blue Wolf and Alpha Blue Wolf.
Alpha Wolf EXP is null with conflicting source notes: individual page reports 41, Monster overview reports 51. Resolve against intended official server/version before using EXP in gameplay.
An empty dropItems array only means the individual page lists no items in the captured drop section; it does not imply no Yang or no shared/alternative drops.
Added individual Metin pages for Metin of Sorrow, Combat, Battle and Soul, including their listed monster spawns, map locations and item groups where captured.
Metin of Battle drop groups are partial in this capture; do not use empty armour/other arrays to infer confirmed no drops.

Added raw drop groups from a public community Metin2 server-file repository for matching early monsters. These are legacy community data, not official Gameforge tables; VNUMs are preserved and raw rates are not presented as percentages.

Captured a second independent community server drop file for monster VNUMs 102, 103, 104, 105, 131, 132 and 134. This demonstrates server-specific differences: these records are kept in a separate comparison array, not merged into the first drop set.

changeLog: v11: added VNUM-to-name lookup for mob/item IDs in the two separate community drop datasets; provenance and compatibility caveats retained.
v12: attached resolved VNUM name references to each community drop entry and added data-quality/source-policy audit summary; community data remain isolated from official facts.
v13: resolved Alpha Wolf EXP display value using the official overview table (51 EXP) while preserving the conflicting individual-page value (41) as a source note.

changeLog.change: Assigned a custom 20% drop chance to every currently catalogued monster drop item. This is a game-design rule, not an official Metin2 rate; catalog is still reference-only until index.html loads it.
Changed all currently catalogued monster drop item chances from 20% to 10% as a custom game-design rule; not official Metin2 rates.
Added verified official-wiki category source index for weapons, armour and equipment to guide systematic item cataloguing; this is an index, not a claim that all equipment has been imported.

Added three low-level sword equipment records from the official Warrior weapons wiki table, including base stats and upgrade Yang costs; upgrade materials deliberately left unresolved where table parsing was ambiguous.

Bulk-imported 54 named weapon and armour entries from official category indexes. Records intentionally contain only verified category membership; stats, exact upgrade recipes, and monster drops remain unfilled until individual pages are checked.
Expanded official equipment source index across accessory categories and added 36 individually linked upgrade/refinement/craft material records with explicit unresolved recipe/drop status.

Expanded Warrior weapon table import with 15 sword/two-handed weapon records, level requirements, base attack values, speed, sockets, and upgrade Yang costs from official wiki. Material item names/quantities left unfilled rather than guessed.

upgradeRules.rule: Equipable items are commonly upgraded to +9; some systems allow higher values. Upgrade attempts usually require Yang and upgrade materials.
NPC upgrades can destroy an item on failure depending on the upgrade method; refinement items can offer different failure outcomes.
Craft/refinement materials and upgrade materials are related but not identical categories; some items can be used in both.
Spirit stones provide persistent equipment bonuses when successfully inserted into supported equipment; insertion can fail and leave a broken slot.

knownRules.rule: Knihy majú časový odstup medzi čítaniami; oficiálna wiki uvádza približne 18 až 30 hodín a predmet Exorcism Scroll môže cooldown preskočiť.
Duchovné kamene dávajú bonus po vložení do podporovanej výbavy; vloženie môže zlyhať a poškodiť slot.
Truhlice môžu obsahovať Yang, skúsenosti, bežné alebo vzácne predmety, prípadne príšery; časť vyžaduje kľúč.

Podľa oficiálnej wiki hráč, ktorý je o 16 alebo viac úrovní vyššie než príšera, nezískava z nej EXP ani predmety; pred implementáciou treba potvrdiť, že táto verzia pravidla zodpovedá cieľovej verzii hry.
Joan, Pyungmoo a Yongan sú tri kráľovské varianty Mapy 1; rovnaké základné príšery sa vyskytujú vo všetkých troch.

rawCommunityDropData.sourceType: public community server files, not official Gameforge drop tables
rawCommunityDropData.caution: Legacy/community server data. Raw rate columns are engine-specific parameters, not guaranteed percentages and not guaranteed to match current official servers. Do not use these values as official drop chances.

dropSourceComparisons.sourceType: community server files; not official Gameforge rates
dropSourceComparisons.interpretation: Raw engine parameters only. In this repository the same mob VNUMs can have very different drops from another community repository; do not merge these sets or interpret rawRate as a percent without matching server source/config and item_proto.

communityVnumNameLookup.sourceType: name lookup from public community server files; not an official Gameforge dataset
communityVnumNameLookup.caution: Names are mapped by VNUM from a separate reference server pack. They help decode raw drop files but do not prove the same item/mob names or drops exist in current official Gameforge servers.

dataQualityReport.purpose: Audit and organization summary; not game runtime data.

sourcePolicy.officialWiki: Use for publicly documented item/monster/map facts; record exact page URL and what the page actually confirms.
sourcePolicy.communityServerFiles: Keep in isolated community-only sections. Never treat rawRate as a percentage without confirming that file's engine semantics.
sourcePolicy.unresolved: Keep null or explicitly unresolved rather than inventing a value.
sourcePolicy.runtime: The game currently does not load this JSON; this is reference catalog only.

knownLimitations: Community item and mob names come from a different public server pack; they are VNUM-based hints, not proof of current official Gameforge naming.
